suggested_change: Rewrite rubric to define: (1) regression tolerance—explicitly allow score maintenance if no contradictory evidence, not just absence of positive evidence; (2) competition scoring—require 1/10 for unnamed/vague competitors, not 4/10; (3) next-step completeness—define 'specific, concrete question' with examples; (4) evidence completeness—separate 'score justification' from 'evidence narrative' to prevent circular logic on quantified metrics.
